Only room tone accompanies the dialogue.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a fixed close-up of <Subject 2>'s lips continuing to move as he finishes the sentence, <d>[Chinese] 赌博挥霍只剩八万。</d> Then a fast cut to <Subject 1> 姜宝强's face: his eyes are bloodshot, hands still gripping both sides of his head, and he screams in emotional collapse, <d>[Chinese] 不可能！那是我的婚房！</d> His shrill scream fills the frame, with a faint low electric hum in the background.
